name: train_spec_kai_sa
description: Dispatch marker for the Kai'Sa specialist (riftlab.yml, request=lab/specs/train_spec_kai_sa.json, chain=N): see train_spec_kennen.json. Trained on its own decisions with Kai'Sa against loop.SPECIALISTS['kai_sa'] jury, with its legend's human RiftLite decisions weighted --spec-human-weight; ladder lab/learn/specialists/kai_sa/.
note: 6 Nov noon: 12 jury rejections in a row, also with self-play at 200 simulations. Wider net (256 hidden, widened from the 128 one) and Riven drawn 3x as often in self-play (Kai'Sa vs Riven is simulated 10 points too favourable to Riven). 13 Nov 22:40 UTC (Jeremy: 'entraînement sur Voli, Morde, Riven et Evelynn après ban', away for the weekend): post-ban track (loop._POSTBAN_TRACKS: lists and opponents without the banned cards, continuous mode, a net committed every 6 iterations), 2 of the 20 runners.
